parameters.name: AclIds
parameters.description: The ACL IDs. You can specify a maximum of 20 ACL IDs in each request.

parameters.name: AclName
parameters.description:
The ACL name. You can specify a maximum of ACL names in each request.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

>  If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the **request ID** as the **client token**. The **request ID** may be different for each request.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: **1** to **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The token that is used for the next query. Valid values:

*   If this is your first and only query, ignore this parameter.
*   If a subsequent query is to be performed, set the parameter to the value of NextToken that is returned from the last call.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the Global Accelerator (GA) instance is deployed. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ga list-acls --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --acl-ids nacl-hp34s2h0xx1ht4nwo0000 --acl-name test-acl --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a0000 --max-results 10 --resource-group-id rg-aek2lgw4evw0000 --tag Value=tag-value Key=tag-key --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ga ListAcls --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key 'tag-key' --NextToken caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a0000 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-aek2lgw4evw0000' --AclIds.1 'nacl-hp34s2h0xx1ht4nwo0000' --MaxResults 10 --Tag.1.Value 'tag-value' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000' --AclName 'test-acl' --method POST --force
